panels.title: feat: voice practice call inside ChatGPT
panels.scene: Knight casually hands a glowing magical scroll to a weeping villager. The scroll is visibly talking, surrounded by floating musical notes and noise waves. Villagers bow on the ground in utter shock.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: THE PAPER TALKS BACK! IT HAS A HUMAN SOUL!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It's just an audio stream inside ChatGPT.

panels.title: feat: show a scorecard after the ChatGPT practice call
panels.scene: A massive golden tablet crashes into the village square, glowing red with the text 'GRADE: C-'. A villager falls to his knees, staring at it in total despair.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: THE MAGIC TABLET SCORER HAS SEEN MY SIN OF POOR GRAMMAR!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It shows your stats when the call ends.

panels.title: Integrate scorecards into voice calls
panels.scene: A villager finishes shouting into a glowing magical orb. A mini ghost pops out of the orb and hands him a tiny report card. Villagers in the background throw confetti and cry tears of joy.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: IT LISTENED TO ME AND GAVE ME A REPORT CARD! WE ARE SAVED!

panels.title: 2 commits. 1 voice system. 1 scorecard.
panels.scene: Knight sits exhausted on a wooden barrel, drinking water. Behind him, villagers are busy chiseling a giant stone statue of a magical scorecard.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our newborn baby Practice Call!
